Daily Devotional

August 10

2 Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death. 3 The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked. (Proverbs 10:2-3 KJV)

Money and all our physical possessions will all pass away some day (2 Peter 3:10), but the Christian should always pursue a righteous life, as it is much more valuable than money (1 Peter 1:16). When you keep your mind on the spiritual and eternal things, and lay up your treasures in heaven instead of on earth (Matthew 6:20), you will prosper in eternity and not just in this life on earth.

This famish is not talking about being hungry, but is speaking about the desires of the soul. The Lord will not let the righteous go hungry in their souls. The person who is living in right standing with the Lord will have a continual feast (Proverbs 15:15). Of course you have to be operating in faith, as without faith it is impossible to please the Lord, and appropriate His blessings in our lives (Hebrews 11:6). Even though we have the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23) in our spirits at all times, we must release it by faith. You can not benefit from the fruit of the Spirit if you don’t know that it is there, and what it is. Read the bible and understand what all you already have – praise God.
